# 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception)

Generated by `npm run build` from the feature files in `src/components/` and the step definitions in `src/tests/_shared-steps/`. Edit those, not this file.

Level AAA. [Understanding 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception) on w3.org](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/keyboard-no-exception.html).

Scenarios: automatic.

## Setup

- [`Given I load the sample "<input-url>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/1-Given/samples-load.js) — Loads a sample to test from a web URL.
- [`When I view the rendered "<selector>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-viewed.js) — Checks an element is visibly rendered on the page.
- [`When I click on "<selector>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/mouse-events-occur.js) — Clicks an element with the primary mouse button
- [`When I focus "<selector>" using a keyboard`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-focused.js) — Focuses an element using the keyboard. Note: Will activate :focus-visible styles.
- [`When I focus "<selector>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-focused.js) — Focuses an element programmatically (without a keyboard press). Note: May not activate :focus-visible styles.
- [`When I press the "<key>" key once`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/keyboard-events-occur.js) — Presses a key on the keyboard.

## Assertions

- [`Then every interactive control should be reachable using the keyboard`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/keyboard-checks.js) — Automatically checks every rendered control inside the element receives focus when sweeping with Tab, and with the arrow keys inside composite widgets such as a tab list. Note: Open or expand the component first, so the controls you want checked are rendered.
- [`Then "<selector>" should be focused`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element is currently focused.
- [`Then the URL should change`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/context-checks.js) — Automatically checks that the URL changes. Note: Does not validate the page content actually changes.

## Example

```gherkin
Background:
  Given I load the sample "http://localhost:8081/accordion/examples/default"

@2.1.3 @aaa @automatic
Rule: 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception), Level AAA
  Scenario: The accordion component is accessible by keyboard, with no exceptions
    When I view the rendered ".tl-accordion"
    Then every interactive control should be reachable using the keyboard
```
